title: Suspicious Shipments/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "This vessel appears to be part of a larger operation. Its purpose remains unclear but the threat is obvious. Do not let this ship reach its destination. Eliminate the crew."
- Lotus: "Tenno, the level of resistance you are encountering is far beyond anything I had predicted. Something valuable is aboard this ship."
- Lotus: "Tenno, the security force on this ship is unlike anything I've seen on a Corpus transport. We need to find out what is going on here."
- Lotus: "Radio silence and intense security indicate that someone is trying very hard to keep this ship and its cargo a secret. Look out for anything out of the ordinary."
